name: Houjou Souta
source: A prodigy who achieved the rank of San-dan in the Shoreikai at the age of 13. Though he appears as a quiet young boy, his demeanor changes when he stands in front of the board.
translation: A prodigy who achieved the rank of San-dan in the Shoreikai at the age of 13. Though he appears as a quiet young boy, his demeanor changes when he stands in front of the board.
